payload.subject: Governed Operation from Operator Branches
payload.name: Governed Operation from Operator Branches
payload.purpose: Make SYNTH govern work on pre-existing operator branches: declare and bind execution branches (ADR-056 --branch/--no-create), anchor and single-write the ceremony ledger (ADR-055: ledger writer, anchor, single writer), and make delivery and abandonment first-class ceremonies (deliver/seal/close/abandon) so finished work, files and history survive the branch lifecycle instead of being stranded or wiped.
